items.title: 1 Industrials Stock on Our Watchlist and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities. Still, their generally high capital requirements expose them to the ups and downs of economic cycles, and the market seems to be baking in a prolonged downturn as the industry has shed 2.5% over the past six months. This drop is a stark contrast from the S&P 500’s 10.8% gain.

items.title: Before The Surge, Caterpillar Stock’s Order Book Told A Different Story
items.summary: The stock looked sleepy and its latest revenue print was down, but a careful look at the company’s backlog revealed a substantial increase in order volume was developing just beneath the surface.

items.title: What Separates DE Stock From Its Peers Right Now
items.summary: The iconic green tractor company is priced like the best operator in its field, but its results are still trying to catch up to the market's high expectations.

items.title: Which Heavy Machinery Stock Is Dominating in 2026: Caterpillar, Deere, or PACCAR?
items.summary: One heavy machinery giant is beating Wall Street while its entire industry collapses around it, and another is riding three booming end markets at once. The 2026 scoreboard reveals how differently construction, agriculture, and freight cycles reward patient investors.

items.title: Caterpillar Stock Is Priced To Swing Hundreds Of Dollars Either Way
items.summary: The width comes from how much this stock already moves, not from an unusual premium on its options.

items.title: 5 Strategic Buyers That Could Transform Aurora Innovation Into an Industry Powerhouse
items.summary: Aurora Innovation operates the only driverless Class 8 trucks running at scale on U.S. public roads, and that monopoly position is drawing serious attention from some of the heaviest hitters in freight and tech.

items.title: 1 Unpopular Stock That Deserves a Second Chance and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: When Wall Street turns bearish on a stock, it’s worth paying attention. These calls stand out because analysts rarely issue grim ratings on companies for fear their firms will lose out in other business lines such as M&A advisory.

items.title: Caterpillar's Falling Multiple Rests On Margin, Not Its Backlog
items.summary: Consensus already expects the revenue boom to fade, leaving margin to do much of the work of bringing the multiple down.
